newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends easier on dollar crunch.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends easier on dollar crunch.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka ended easier at 42.8480/8500 on short supply of dollars before the market closed for the Moslem Friday weekend, dealers said.

The taka opened flat at 42.8450/8500 but later slipped slightly after state-owned banks chased the greenback for payments of oil import bills. "As pressure on the dollar kept mounting many of the banks were reluctant to sell the currency to keep long positions," said one dealer with a foreign bank.
Interbank call money rates closed higher at 5.5 percent to 6.0 percent against the previous at 5.25 to 5.75 percent.
